name: Three Concrete Square-Boundary Attachments of Order 3494
definition: Attach three copies of the certified $1165$-concept square-boundary piece to the three horizontal squares of the eleven-vertex attachment core, identifying each copy's marked square with its corresponding central square and otherwise using disjoint private coordinates.
parameters: Every assembly has $11+3(1165-4)=3494$ concepts and $40$ active coordinates. The eight alignments are indexed by the three opposite-hole-pair bits $(h_0,h_1,h_2)$.
properties: Every alignment peels relatively to the target edge $\{0,8\}$. In particular, the formerly unresolved alignment $(0,0,1)$ has a fully replayed relative order. The result uses the concrete piece's ability to retain all four punctured square boundaries; it does not settle the same alignment for arbitrary pieces known to retain only the two prescribed opposite punctures.
